answered.sql: SELECT Studio.name FROM Studio JOIN Movie ON Studio.id = Movie.studio_id WHERE Movie.release_date = (SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM Movie)

candidates.meaning: Find the director of the latest movie based on release date.
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name FROM Director D JOIN Movie M ON D.id = M.director_id ORDER BY M.release_date DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Find the director of the most recent movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT Director.name FROM Director JOIN Movie ON Director.id = Movie.director_id ORDER BY Movie.release_date DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Find the actor who played the latest movie's lead role.
candidates.sql: SELECT Actor.first_name, Actor.last_name FROM Actor JOIN Role ON Actor.id = Role.actor_id JOIN Movie ON Role.movie_id = Movie.id WHERE Role.character = 'Lead' ORDER BY Movie.release_date DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Find the studio that produced the latest movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT Studio.name FROM Studio JOIN Movie ON Studio.id = Movie.studio_id ORDER BY Movie.release_date DESC LIMIT 1
